classes.name: ExternalPermitPersistenceModule
classes.description: Backend-neutral persistence module that owns durable external-permit issuance, policy, revocation, and kill-switch behavior across SQLite and PostgreSQL adapters.

classes.name: ExternalPermitRevocation
classes.description: Idempotent durable denial of a permit revocation handle, recorded atomically with its immutable audit decision.

classes.name: ImmutableAuditDecision
classes.description: Chained decision record that preserves actor, reason, target, timestamp, evidence, and outcome for a governed mutation.

classes.name: ChiseiGrpcTransportAdapter
classes.description: gRPC adapter that authenticates callers, enforces transport admission, maps protocol messages and errors, and delegates durable behavior to domain modules.

relations.name: delegates_permit_revocation_to
relations.description: The gRPC transport delegates external-permit revocation and its audit obligation to the persistence module.

relations.name: atomically_records_revocation
relations.description: The persistence module records revocation state and its audit decision in one backend transaction.

relations.name: is_evidenced_by_audit_decision
relations.description: Every newly persisted external-permit revocation is evidenced by exactly one immutable audit decision.
